papers.ja_title: オープンワールド AI に必要な 3 つの条件を言語モデルで検証
papers.summary: あらかじめ全てのタスクが分かっている閉じた世界と違い、開いた世界では未知のタスクに少ない例と事前知識で対応する汎用性が求められる。この論文はタスクが潜在的な要因を共有すると仮定して学習目的を分解し、推論時に学習する能力・iid 一般化以上の情報を保つ豊かな表現・入力と出力を対応づける予測的な分離という 3 条件を導き出した。最大 8B パラメータの言語モデルで、量 (どれだけ勝つか) ではなく性質 (条件を満たすか否か) を調べたところ、条件を満たすモデルは関連タスクのデータが増えるほど性能が伸び、満たさないモデルはモデルサイズを大きくしても層の種類を混ぜても改善しなかった。
papers.why: モデル構造を設計する人にとって、スケールや層構成の工夫だけでは汎用性 (開いた世界への対応力) は補えないという、構造設計の指針になる実験的証拠を提供する。
papers.summary_en: Unlike the closed world where all tasks and iid data are known in advance, the open world demands versatility: handling unforeseen tasks from few examples with little prior design. By modeling tasks as sharing latent factors and decomposing the training objective, the paper derives three requirements: inference-time learning, a rich representation retaining more than iid generalization needs, and predictive disentanglement aligning inputs and outputs. Testing language models up to 8B for whether they qualitatively satisfy these properties (rather than how much they win quantitatively), models meeting the requirements improve as related-task data accumulates, while the rest degrade, and neither scale nor layer-type interleaving repairs this.
papers.why_en: For people designing model architectures, this gives experimental evidence that scaling or mixing layer types alone cannot substitute for the structural properties needed for open-world versatility.

papers.title: Task-Phase-Conditioned Expert Routing Is Not a Reliable Proxy for Quantization Sensitivity in MoE FFN Tensors
papers.abstract: We investigate whether per-layer, per-task-phase (prompt/reasoning/response) expert-routing statistics in a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors (down/gate and up). To attain layerwise routing statistics, we build a routing-capture and profiling pipeline for Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B in ik_llama.cpp, derive a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy/decisiveness, coefficient of variation (CV), Jaccard/phase-fragility, and top-1 expert strength, and use coordinate descent to tune a layer allocation that respects a fixed average bits-per-weight budget. Notably, the profiling pipeline is applicable to standard top-k MoE architectures. Across independent experimental conditions (about 4.0 bpw flat, about 2.7 bpw steep, and about 2.7 bpw random allocation as a control), reallocation fails to outperform the uniform baseline within each quality tier. In the flat regime, reallocation is statistically neutral (z about 0.9). For the steep tier, the random reallocation performs within 1 SE of the routing-guided reallocation at the same tier, indicating a structural loss at this quality rung caused by mandatory downgrades and Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) tail injection. This aggressive-budget condition shows a decisive loss (z greater than 4 SE) replicated across three independent weight vectors. We argue that the deeper issue is that routing-behavior statistics are an unvalidated proxy for true per-layer quantization cost.
papers.ja_title: MoE のエキスパート選択統計は量子化感度の良い目印にならない
papers.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (複数の専門家ネットワークを切り替えて使う) 言語モデルで、どのエキスパートがどれだけ使われたかという統計 (ルーティング統計) から、層ごとの量子化 (重みを少ないビット数で表す) の割り当てを決められるか調べた。Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B でルーティングのエントロピーや変動係数などから感度スコアを作り、ビット予算を一定にして層ごとの割り当てを最適化したが、平均 4.0 ビット相当・約 2.7 ビット相当のどちらでも、この割り当ては単純な均等割りに対して統計的に優位にならなかった。むしろ約 2.7 ビットの厳しい条件では、ランダムな割り当てとほぼ同じ結果 (均等割りに z > 4 SE で劣る) になり、ルーティング統計は量子化コストの代わりにはならないと結論した。
papers.why: 量子化の割り当て指標を作る人にとって、「使われ方の統計だけで量子化の難しさを測れる」という仮説を実測で否定した反例であり、評価設計の落とし穴を示す良い参考になる。
papers.summary_en: The paper asks whether per-layer expert-routing statistics (which experts fire how often, at what entropy) in a Mixture-of-Experts language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors. Using Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B, a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy, coefficient of variation, and related metrics was used to optimize a layer allocation under a fixed bit budget, but at both roughly 4.0 bpw and roughly 2.7 bpw this reallocation failed to beat a uniform baseline, and at the aggressive 2.7 bpw tier it was statistically indistinguishable from a random allocation and decisively worse than uniform (z greater than 4 SE). The authors conclude that routing-behavior statistics are an unvalidated, and apparently poor, proxy for true per-layer quantization cost.
papers.why_en: For anyone designing mixed-precision allocation heuristics, this is a concrete counterexample showing a plausible-sounding proxy (routing statistics) fails under controlled measurement, a useful caution about evaluation design.

review.note: 一見合理的な指標 (ルーティング統計) が量子化コストの代わりになるという仮説を、ランダム割り当てとの比較や複数の重みベクトルでの再現実験によって統計的に検証し反証する手法。
review.note_en: Shows how to statistically test and falsify a plausible proxy metric (routing statistics) against a random-allocation control and replicate across independent weight vectors.

papers.title: Long-Context Drafting Does Not Require Long-Context Drafters
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding pairs a cheap drafter with parallel verification against the target. At ultra-long context it stops paying, because a drafter that attends over the full prefix inherits the target's context-dependent cost, so the speedup it was meant to provide first erodes and then reverses. The standard response is to build a long-context drafter, by training or fine-tuning one, or by using a multi-token-prediction head shipped inside the target checkpoint. We argue this is unnecessary, because the drafters in use are target-conditioned, reading hidden states the target computed over the entire prefix, so distant context already reaches them without their own attention, and verification corrects what they miss. We therefore freeze released short-context drafters and run them far past their training length under two inference-time mechanisms, one bounding the attention cache they see, which fixes their cost, and one re-basing their rotary position indices into the trained range. No weight is touched and the only tunable saturates early, so one vLLM-side configuration spans 4k to two million tokens, costing at most 0.16x of speedup at short length. We prove when a common index shift leaves the drafter's computation exactly unchanged, and decompose acceptance into two measurable gaps with sharp bounds. Whatever speedup a frozen drafter delivers at short context, it retains out to two million tokens, across three target-drafter pairs and five corpora. The claim concerns the flatness rather than the multiple, and removing either mechanism eliminates it. The gain is conditional on the speculative cost per emitted token staying below the matched target-only cost.
papers.ja_title: 短い文脈用のドラフトモデルは長い文脈でもそのまま使える
papers.summary: 投機的デコード (安いドラフトモデルで候補を作り本体モデルで検証して高速化する手法) は、文脈が極端に長くなるとドラフトモデルも全文脈を読む必要が出てコストが膨らみ、速度向上が消えてむしろ遅くなる問題があった。この研究は既存のドラフトモデルを重みを変えずに使い、見るキャッシュの範囲を制限する仕組みと、回転位置エンコーディングの番号を学習時の範囲に戻す仕組みの 2 つを推論時に加えるだけで、4000 トークンから 200 万トークンまで同じ設定で速度低下を最大 0.16 倍 (ほぼ無視できる程度) に抑えられることを示した。3 つの本体・ドラフトの組み合わせと 5 種類のデータで、短い文脈で得られた高速化が 200 万トークンまでそのまま保たれることを確認した。
papers.why: 超長文脈での推論高速化を作る人にとって、新しいドラフトモデルを学習し直さずに既存のものを使い回せるという、コストの低い実装指針を与える。
papers.summary_en: Speculative decoding stops paying off at ultra-long context because a drafter that attends over the full prefix inherits the target's context-dependent cost, eroding and then reversing the speedup. The paper freezes existing short-context drafters and adds two inference-time mechanisms — bounding the attention cache the drafter sees, and re-basing its rotary position indices into the trained range — with no weight changes, so one vLLM configuration spans 4k to two million tokens at at most 0.16x of the speedup lost at short length. Across three target-drafter pairs and five corpora, whatever speedup a frozen drafter delivers at short context is retained out to two million tokens.
papers.why_en: For people building ultra-long-context inference serving, this gives a cheap way to reuse existing short-context drafters without retraining, via two inference-time tricks.

papers.title: How to Train Your Little Dragon: Teaching a Small Language Model to Construct and Refine GPU Optimization Scripts
papers.abstract: Compiler transformations interact, making GPU kernel optimization a search for combinations that preserve the computation while improving performance. We introduce HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON, a training method that teaches a small language model both to construct complete optimization scripts and to improve existing ones. Instead of ranking candidates or generating kernel code, our model generates optimization scripts. We devise a compact, lossless representation whose deterministic decoding reconstructs the exact compiler trace, preserving its transformation parameters and dependencies. We use a compiler framework TVM MetaSchedule to build training data on 54,116 distinct workloads, and construct 108,594 examples in two training sets: 60,236 teach the model to generate an optimized script from an unoptimized kernel, while 48,358 teach it to produce a better script given the kernel and a somewhat optimized script. Supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to construct and improve optimization scripts from these search-derived examples. We then add reinforcement learning with a shaped reward that combines correctness with measured performance, awarding a latency-based bonus only to numerically correct kernels. We apply this training method to a model with 8 billion parameters. After supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, the model achieves per-attempt correctness of 91.27% for construction and 92.01% for refinement, while reinforcement learning produces faster kernels than supervised training on 88 of 102 construction tasks and 145 of 170 refinement prompts. With only 8B parameters, our LITTLE DRAGON achieves higher per-attempt correctness and better kernel performance than six frontier LLMs: GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5, Kimi-K3, and GLM-5.3 among them, each with hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters, for which task-specific training is unavailable or expensive.
papers.ja_title: 8B の小型モデルで GPU カーネル最適化スクリプトを自動生成・改善
papers.summary: GPU カーネルの最適化はコンパイラの変換 (タイル分割やループ展開など) を組み合わせる探索問題で、組み合わせ同士が影響し合うため難しい。本研究は TVM MetaSchedule で 54,116 種類の作業負荷から 10 万件超の学習データを作り、8B パラメータの小型言語モデルに最適化スクリプトの生成と改善の両方を教師あり学習させ、さらに正しさと速度の両方を評価する強化学習を追加した。結果、1 回の試行での正解率は生成タスクで 91.27%、改善タスクで 92.01% に達し、GPT-6 Astra や Opus 5 など数百億〜数兆パラメータの最前線 LLM 6 種より、正解率とカーネル速度の両方で上回った。
papers.why: カーネル最適化スクリプトの自動生成において、小さなモデルに専用学習させれば巨大な汎用 LLM を上回れることを示し、カーネル開発の自動化基盤を低コストで作る指針になる。
papers.summary_en: GPU kernel optimization is a search over interacting compiler transformations, which is hard to navigate. The authors build over 100,000 training examples from 54,116 workloads via TVM MetaSchedule, teach an 8B language model to both construct optimization scripts from scratch and refine existing ones via supervised fine-tuning, then add reinforcement learning with a correctness-plus-latency reward. The resulting model reaches per-attempt correctness of 91.27% (construction) and 92.01% (refinement), and outperforms six frontier LLMs with hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters, including GPT-6 Astra and Opus 5, in both correctness and kernel performance.
papers.why_en: This shows that a small, task-trained 8B model can beat much larger frontier LLMs at generating/refining GPU optimization scripts, a cost-effective recipe for automating kernel tuning infrastructure.

papers.title: Cyclotron: A Recurrence Language for Expressing Interprocessor Communication
papers.abstract: We present Cyclotron, a compiler that expresses streaming dataflow algorithms using recurrence equations, which are then compiled to distributed topologies of interlinked processors. Our compiler lowers a language of recurrences over logical iteration spaces into per-processor programs of sends, receives, and computations. In these recurrences, data accesses are not limited to external accesses to memory; data can live separately on the iteration space itself, allowing internal points to communicate values directly with other points. Users specify this communication directly in the recurrence language, which allows them to express various communication patterns such as a nearest-neighbor systolic exchange, a one-to-all broadcast, a bidirectional split ring, or an asymmetric and piecewise broadcast pattern, which are often not supported by standard distributed linear algebra libraries. These recurrences describe the algorithm and communication independently of how they map onto the hardware. A programmer then chooses which dimensions execute across processors and which execute over time, without rewriting the entire program. Users only specify data dependencies across the iteration space, and the compiler safely generates a program, per process, with correct placement of both communication and computational operators according to the chosen space--time mapping. We evaluate distributed matrix multiplication, TRSM, Cholesky, and fused Cholesky--TRSM on up to 16 CPU nodes and 16 GPUs, comparing against ScaLAPACK, SLATE, and cuSolverMp. Cyclotron is competitive with and often outperforms these hand-optimized libraries; for Cholesky, the best communication strategy changes with problem size and architecture.
papers.theme: 集団通信・ネットワーク
papers.ja_title: 再帰方程式だけで分散プロセッサ間の通信パターンを記述するコンパイラ Cyclotron
papers.summary: 複数の CPU や GPU をまたぐ分散線形代数 (行列演算) では、最近傍交換や一対全ブロードキャストなど様々な通信パターンが必要だが、既存の分散線形代数ライブラリはこれらを柔軟に表現できないことが多い。Cyclotron は計算と通信をまとめて再帰方程式として書けるようにし、どの次元をプロセッサに割り当て、どの次元を時間方向に回すかをユーザが選ぶだけで、コンパイラが各プロセッサ用の送受信・計算プログラムを自動生成する。16 個の CPU ノードと 16 個の GPU で行列乗算・TRSM・Cholesky 分解などを評価したところ、手作業で最適化された ScaLAPACK・SLATE・cuSolverMp と同等かそれ以上の性能を示し、Cholesky では問題サイズやアーキテクチャによって最適な通信方法が変わることも分かった。
papers.why: 分散学習・分散推論で使う集団通信の実装を手で書き分けずに、再帰方程式とタイル割当の指定だけで生成できる仕組みは、通信パターンの実装・検証コストを下げる基盤になる。
papers.summary_en: Distributed linear algebra across many CPUs/GPUs needs various communication patterns such as nearest-neighbor exchange or one-to-all broadcast, which standard distributed linear algebra libraries often cannot express flexibly. Cyclotron is a compiler that expresses both computation and communication as recurrence equations over an iteration space, letting users choose which dimensions run across processors versus over time, and automatically generates correctly-placed per-processor send/receive/compute programs. Evaluated on matrix multiplication, TRSM, Cholesky, and fused Cholesky-TRSM across up to 16 CPU nodes and 16 GPUs, Cyclotron is competitive with, and often outperforms, hand-optimized libraries ScaLAPACK, SLATE, and cuSolverMp, and reveals that for Cholesky the best communication strategy changes with problem size and architecture.
papers.why_en: For people implementing collective communication in distributed training/inference, this offers a way to generate various communication patterns from a recurrence specification plus a space-time mapping choice, rather than hand-coding each pattern.

papers.title: Do As I Do, Not As I Say: On-Policy Distillation Inherits the Teacher in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Improving the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) often relies on post-training with supervision from stronger models. Two common strategies are supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which trains on teacher-generated demonstrations, and on-policy distillation (OPD), which provides teacher feedback on trajectories generated by the student itself. While OPD can be more data-efficient by supervising student-generated trajectories, it is unclear how the teacher's supervision at each state affects the student's learned behavior. To study this question, we conduct a controlled comparison of OPD and filtered SFT across data budgets and tasks where the teacher exhibits different levels of reliability, and analyze how these differences shape student accuracy and completion behavior. Across the two tasks, we find that OPD is effective only when the teacher remains reliable on student-generated trajectories. On ChartQA, where the teacher completes 99% of its solutions, OPD trained on only 10% of the data comes within 1.4 accuracy points of full-data SFT. In contrast, on Geometry3K, where the teacher fails to complete 22% of its solutions, OPD underperforms SFT by 7.9 points, with most of the gap explained by incomplete responses. More strikingly, starting OPD from an SFT student reduces its completion rate from 76% to 62%, effectively erasing the completion behavior learned through SFT. Filtering teacher demonstrations for completeness alone recovers much of SFT's advantage. These results show that on-policy supervision can transfer not only teacher knowledge but also persistent failure modes on student-visited states. Code is available at https://github.com/ffy208/opd-inherits-teacher-vlm.
papers.ja_title: オンポリシー蒸留は教師モデルの失敗癖も一緒に生徒モデルに伝える
papers.summary: 視覚言語モデルの推論能力を伸ばすには、強い教師モデルの模範解答で学ぶ教師あり微調整 (SFT) と、生徒自身が作った軌跡に教師が採点するオンポリシー蒸留 (OPD) という 2 つの方法がある。教師が信頼できる場面 (ChartQA では解答完了率 99%) では OPD はデータ 10% だけで全データ SFT の 1.4 ポイント差まで迫れたが、教師が 22% も解答を完了できない Geometry3K では OPD は SFT に 7.9 ポイント劣り、その差の大部分は生徒の回答が未完了になることで説明できた。さらに、SFT 済みの生徒に OPD を続けると解答完了率が 76% から 62% に下がり、SFT で身についた「最後までやり切る」習慣が消えてしまうことも分かった。
papers.why: 教師モデルの出力をそのまま報酬や模範に使う後学習手法を設計する人にとって、教師の失敗パターンが生徒にそのまま伝わりうるという、評価と学習データ設計の落とし穴を具体的な数字で示している。
papers.summary_en: Improving VLM reasoning via post-training often relies on either supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher demonstrations or on-policy distillation (OPD), where the teacher scores the student's own trajectories. On ChartQA, where the teacher completes 99% of its solutions, OPD with only 10% of the data comes within 1.4 accuracy points of full-data SFT; but on Geometry3K, where the teacher fails to complete 22% of its solutions, OPD underperforms SFT by 7.9 points, mostly explained by incomplete responses. More strikingly, starting OPD from an SFT student drops its completion rate from 76% to 62%, effectively erasing the completion behavior SFT had taught.
papers.why_en: For people designing post-training that uses teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, this gives concrete numbers showing how a teacher's own failure modes (e.g., incomplete reasoning) can be transferred to the student, a concrete pitfall for data/reward design.

review.note: 教師モデルの信頼性が異なる2つのタスクで、データ量を変えた対照比較と完了率の分解分析によって、学習方法 (OPD vs SFT) が実際に何を生徒に伝えているのかを切り分ける手法。
review.note_en: A controlled comparison across tasks with different teacher reliability, plus decomposition into completion-rate effects, to disentangle what on-policy distillation actually transfers to the student.

papers.title: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon GUI agents rely on visual history to maintain task states, but retaining historical screenshots increases visual-token usage and inference costs, while textual summaries can discard critical state information, undermining long-horizon reliability. We propose ECHOES, which leverages training-time privileged information to guide textual history compression and strengthen long-horizon reasoning. Specifically, ECHOES adopts a Compression-Think-Action (CTA) format to recursively update a textual history state and reason. The same model, given privileged multi-image inputs, serves as a teacher that provides dense token-level on-policy distillation on student-generated CTA rollouts. Our Perception-Memory Fidelity (PMF) Gap-guided OPD-RL framework dynamically balances privileged distillation and task-reward optimization, with periodic teacher updates supporting continued improvement. We further introduce ECHOESBMK, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark derived from real GUI agent failure trajectories to jointly evaluate visual perception and cross-modal state retention. Experiments on four GUI benchmarks and ECHOESBMK demonstrate substantial gains in task performance and memory fidelity. Without retaining historical screenshots at deployment, ECHOES achieves competitive performance with a favorable performance-inference-cost trade-off and exhibits positive zero-shot transfer to unseen visual planning tasks.
papers.ja_title: GUI エージェント向け再帰的履歴圧縮と特権知識蒸留 ECHOES
papers.summary: GUI 操作のような長期タスクでは、過去の画面画像をすべて保持すると視覚トークン数が増えて推論コストが上がり、逆にテキスト要約だけにすると重要な状態情報が失われて長期的な信頼性が落ちるという困りごとがある。ECHOES は「圧縮・思考・行動 (CTA)」形式でテキスト履歴を再帰的に更新しつつ、学習時には同じモデルが複数画像を見る教師役となって生成した CTA 系列にトークン単位のオンポリシー蒸留をかける。知覚と記憶のずれ (PMF ギャップ) に応じて蒸留と報酬最適化のバランスを動的に調整する枠組みも提案し、4 つの GUI ベンチマークと新設の診断用ベンチマーク ECHOESBMK で、推論時に過去の画面画像を保持しなくてもタスク性能と状態保持の正確さの両方で大きな改善を達成した。
papers.why: 長期タスクのエージェントで、推論時には重い画像履歴を持たずに軽いテキスト履歴だけで動かせる学習手法であり、GUI 以外の長期対話・自律エージェントの推論コスト削減にも応用できる考え方を示している。
papers.summary_en: Long-horizon GUI agents need visual history to track task state, but keeping screenshots inflates visual-token usage and inference cost, while text-only summaries tend to discard critical state information and hurt long-horizon reliability. ECHOES uses a Compression-Think-Action (CTA) format to recursively update textual history, and during training the same model acts as a privileged teacher with multi-image access, providing dense token-level on-policy distillation on student-generated CTA rollouts, with a PMF-Gap-guided OPD-RL framework dynamically balancing distillation and task-reward optimization. Across four GUI benchmarks plus a new diagnostic benchmark ECHOESBMK, ECHOES achieves substantial gains in task performance and memory fidelity, reaching competitive performance without retaining historical screenshots at deployment and showing a favorable performance-inference-cost trade-off.
papers.why_en: It offers a training recipe where lightweight text-only history can replace heavy image history at inference time for long-horizon agents, a pattern useful beyond GUI agents for cutting inference cost in long-running autonomous/dialogue agents.

papers.title: Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation
papers.abstract: Automatically generating high-performance kernels with LLM-based agents promises substantial gains in development efficiency, but two obstacles remain. First, while increasing multi-turn interaction with execution environments is crucial for refining generation quality, continuous context accumulation rapidly exceeds the model's effective context window. Second, training long-horizon tasks via GRPO inherently incurs sparse rewards due to its reliance on terminal outcome evaluation, severely hindering step-level credit assignment; To address these obstacles, we propose ATRL (Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning), a post-training method that refines GRPO into a compaction-aware, segment-level objective for long-horizon kernel generation. We also design a lightweight agent harness providing cascaded compilation, correctness, and profiling feedback, alongside an Ascend-specific knowledge base injected during agentic RL training and evaluation to compensate for the base model's missing platform expertise. Evaluations on NPUKernelBench and KernelBench, both executed on Ascend hardware, show that ATRL consistently surpasses all baselines, including GRPO, in both correctness and speedup.
papers.ja_title: 圧縮を意識した強化学習による Ascend 向け Triton カーネル自動生成 (ATRL)
papers.summary: LLM エージェントで高性能カーネルを自動生成する際、実行環境との対話を増やすほど生成品質は上がるが、対話を続けるとやり取りの文脈がモデルの有効なコンテキスト窓を超えてしまう。また、長期タスクを GRPO で学習すると最終結果だけを見る報酬がまばらになり、途中のどのステップが良かったかを評価しにくい。これに対し ATRL は GRPO を「圧縮を意識したセグメント単位」の目的関数に改良し、コンパイル・正解性・プロファイリングの段階的フィードバックを与える軽量エージェントと、Ascend 固有の知識ベースを RL 訓練・評価に組み込み、NPUKernelBench と KernelBench の両方で Ascend ハードウェア上、GRPO を含む全ベースラインを正解性と高速化の両方で一貫して上回った。
papers.why: Ascend NPU 向けカーネル自動生成という具体的なタスクを通じて、長期エージェント RL における文脈の圧縮とステップ単位の報酬設計という汎用的な工夫を示しており、他のハードウェア向けカーネル生成 RL にも転用できる手法。
papers.summary_en: Automatically generating high-performance kernels with LLM agents is hampered by two issues: continuous context accumulation from multi-turn environment interaction quickly exceeds the model's effective context window, and training long-horizon tasks via GRPO suffers from sparse, terminal-only rewards that hinder step-level credit assignment. ATRL refines GRPO into a compaction-aware, segment-level objective, paired with a lightweight agent harness giving cascaded compilation/correctness/profiling feedback and an Ascend-specific knowledge base injected during RL training and evaluation. On NPUKernelBench and KernelBench run on Ascend hardware, ATRL consistently surpasses all baselines, including GRPO, in both correctness and speedup.
papers.why_en: It demonstrates, on the concrete task of Ascend kernel generation, generalizable tricks for long-horizon agentic RL—context compaction and step-level reward design—that could transfer to kernel-generation RL on other hardware.

blogs.title: Adaptive Verification Without a Confidence Head
blogs.excerpt: An online-fitted acceptance estimator that lets every draft-model speculator use Adaptive Verification, by predicting the target's acceptance probability from the drafter's own logits and refitting continuously during serving.
blogs.ja_title: 確信度ヘッドなしで Adaptive Verification を使えるようにする、logits から直接推定する受理確率
blogs.summary: vLLM の投機的デコーディング (speculative decoding) には、ドラフトモデルが出したトークンのうち受理されそうなものだけを検証する Adaptive Verification (AV) という高速化がある。これまでは確信度ヘッド (受理確率を予測する専用の小さな層) を持つ DSpark 系のドラフトモデルしか使えなかったが、本記事はドラフトモデル自身の logits から特徴量を作り、サービング中に継続的に係数を再フィットするオンライン推定器を提案し、EAGLE や MTP、DFlash など確信度ヘッドを持たないドラフトモデルでも AV を使えるようにした。
blogs.why: 既存のチェックポイントを再学習せずに投機的デコーディングの高速化を広げる手法で、大バッチ時に計算量を削減したい推論サービング基盤の設計に直接使える。
blogs.summary_en: vLLM's Adaptive Verification (AV) speeds up speculative decoding by trimming low-acceptance-probability draft tokens before the target model's forward pass, but until now it only worked with DSpark-style drafters that ship a dedicated confidence head. This post introduces an online-fitted acceptance estimator that derives a feature from the drafter's own logits to predict the target model's acceptance probability, with coefficients continuously refit to incoming traffic, extending AV to drafters without a confidence head such as EAGLE, MTP, and DFlash.
blogs.why_en: Extends a compute-saving speculative-decoding optimization to existing checkpoints without retraining, directly useful for serving infrastructure trying to cut compute at large batch sizes.

blogs.title: Push-Based KV Transfer to Improve TTFT and TPOT for Disaggregated Inference in vLLM
blogs.excerpt: A push-based NIXL connector for vLLM disaggregated serving: the prefill instance writes KV directly into decode memory over RDMA, taking the router relay, decode-side allocation, and transfer setup off the TTFT critical path.
topics: 集団通信・ネットワーク
blogs.ja_title: KV キャッシュを「push」で送る新 NIXL コネクタ、分離推論の TTFT と TPOT を改善
blogs.summary: vLLM の prefill/decode 分離推論では、これまで decode 側が prefill 側に KV キャッシュ (key-value cache) を取りに行く pull 方式の NIXL 転送を使っており、ルーターの中継や decode 側でのメモリ確保・転送準備がすべて初回トークン生成までの時間 (TTFT) の経路に乗っていた。本記事は prefill インスタンスが RDMA (AWS EFA など) で decode 側メモリへ直接 KV を書き込む push 方式のコネクタを実装し、これらの手順を TTFT のクリティカルパスから外した。
blogs.why: 分離推論 (disaggregated serving) の遅延を決める転送方式そのものを変える改善で、TTFT/TPOT を詰めたい推論基盤の設計に直接関わる。
blogs.summary_en: In vLLM's prefill-decode disaggregated serving, the default pull-based NIXL connector has the decode instance allocate destination blocks, prepare the transfer, and issue a NIXL READ only after the router relays prefill metadata, all of which runs serially on the time-to-first-token (TTFT) critical path. This post introduces a push-based connector where the prefill instance writes KV blocks directly into decode memory over RDMA (e.g., AWS EFA), taking the router relay, decode-side allocation, and transfer setup off that critical path.
blogs.why_en: Changes the transfer scheme that determines disaggregated-serving latency itself, directly relevant to anyone tuning TTFT/TPOT in a serving stack.

blogs.title: Finish RL Training Faster: Bitwise-Consistent, High-Performance, Agent-Driven
blogs.excerpt: We make vLLM rollout and the training forward give bitwise identical logprobs on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B (NVFP4), keep 91% of rollout throughput on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and open-source the agent skill.
blogs.ja_title: 学習と推論で bit 単位まで同じ logprob を出し、RL 学習の数値ずれを無くす
blogs.summary: 強化学習 (RL) の学習ループでは、サンプリング (rollout) に使う推論側の高速カーネルと、勾配計算をする学習側のカーネルが異なる数値を出すため、学習は実際にサンプルを生成したのとは別の方策を最適化してしまう。DeepSeek-V4-Flash では、この数値ずれを示す学習・推論間の KL ダイバージェンスが 2e-3 から 29.9 まで悪化し報酬も落ちていたが、学習側のフォワード計算で vLLM の推論カーネルをそのまま呼び出すように改修したところ、100 ステップの学習全体で毎回の差分 (diff) が 0 になり、rollout のスループットはベースラインの 91.3% を維持した。Mamba ハイブリッド構成の Nemotron-3.5 (NVFP4) でも手法を転用したところ、SWE-bench Pro のスコアがベースラインの 0.56 から 0.22 への低下を示さず安定した。
blogs.why: RL 後学習で「サイレントな数値バグ」が報酬を壊す様子と、その検出・修正方法を定量的に示した例で、学習・推論カーネルを揃える基盤設計の実例として参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: In high-performance RL training, inference-side optimizations change the numerics used during rollout, so the training step ends up optimizing a policy other than the one that actually sampled; on DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the baseline's train-inference KL rose from 2e-3 to 29.9 while reward fell back. The authors make the training forward pass call vLLM's inference kernels directly, modifying those kernels so rollout and training produce bitwise-identical logprobs for every sampled token (diff = 0), achieving 0 diff at every step over 100 training steps at 91.3% of the baseline's rollout throughput; carried over to Nemotron-3.5 (a Mamba hybrid, NVFP4), the consistent run's SWE-bench Pro score holds while the baseline's drops from 0.56 to 0.22.
blogs.why_en: Quantifies how a silent train/inference numeric mismatch can quietly destroy RL reward, and shows a concrete fix, useful as a template for aligning training and inference kernels in RL infrastructure.

review.note: 学習側と推論側のカーネルが同じ入力に対して bit 単位で同じ値を返すかを突き合わせる検証は、RL 学習で報酬が落ちた原因がサイレントな数値ずれかどうかを切り分ける手法として使える。
review.note_en: Checking whether the training-side and inference-side kernels return bitwise-identical values on the same input is a useful way to isolate whether a reward regression in RL training comes from a silent numeric mismatch.

blogs.title: Improve TTFT for Multi-Turn Agentic Workloads with Bi-Directional KV Transfer in vLLM
blogs.excerpt: Bi-directional KV transfer lets vLLM prefill nodes reuse previously computed KV from decode nodes on later conversation turns, cutting redundant prefill recompute and reducing TTFT by up to 3.3x on long multi-turn prompts.
blogs.ja_title: KV キャッシュを decode から prefill へも送り返す双方向転送で、マルチターン対話の TTFT を最大 3.3 倍改善
blogs.summary: マルチターンのエージェント対話では、ターンが進むたびに過去のシステム指示・プロンプト・ツール結果・応答がすべて再送されるが、従来の分離推論は KV キャッシュを prefill から decode へ一方向にしか送らないため、decode 側に残っている直前の応答分の KV を prefill 側が再利用できず、同じ計算をやり直していた。本記事は KV キャッシュを decode 側から prefill 側へも送り返す双方向転送と、KV キャッシュの所在を把握するルーター、保持期間 (TTL)、再計算のしきい値を組み合わせ、長いマルチターンのプロンプトで TTFT を最大 3.3 倍改善したと報告している。
blogs.why: マルチターンのエージェントワークロードで繰り返されていた無駄な再計算を転送方式の変更だけで減らす例で、対話型エージェントを支える推論基盤の設計に直結する。
blogs.summary_en: In multi-turn agentic workloads, each new turn resends the growing conversation history, but conventional prefill-decode disaggregation only transfers KV cache one way (prefill to decode), so the prefill node cannot reuse the KV cache for the decode node's previously generated response tokens and must recompute them. This post introduces bi-directional KV transfer, combined with a KV-cache-aware router, block retention TTL, and a KV recompute threshold, reporting up to a 3.3x reduction in TTFT on long multi-turn prompts.
blogs.why_en: Cuts redundant prefill recomputation that repeats across turns of agentic workloads purely through a transfer-direction change, directly relevant to serving infrastructure behind conversational agents.

blogs.title: vLLM Support for NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72: 7.8x Throughput over GB200 NVL72
blogs.excerpt: vLLM now runs on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 with day-0 model support, Rubin-tuned FlashInfer kernels, and locality-aware MoE, delivering 7.8x the per-GPU throughput of GB200 NVL72 on AgentX.
blogs.ja_title: vLLM が NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 に対応、GB200 NVL72 比で GPU あたり最大 7.8 倍のスループット
blogs.summary: vLLM は次世代 GPU プラットフォーム NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 に初期対応し、Blackwell 世代向けカーネルがそのまま動く「Day-0」対応に加え、FlashInfer 0.7.0 による Rubin 向けの attention・GEMM・MoE カーネル調整、CUDA 13.4 の locality domain を使って MoE の重みを近いメモリから読む局所性最適化を行った。Vera Rubin は GB200 NVL72 比で NVFP4 の FLOPS が 5 倍、HBM 帯域が約 2.4 倍、NVLink 双方向帯域が 1.7 倍あり、AgentX ベンチマークで同等の対話性を保ったまま GPU あたりスループットが 7.8 倍、MLPerf の VLM スループットは GB300 NVL72 比で最大 3.7 倍になったという。
blogs.why: 新世代 GPU プラットフォーム向けにサービングエンジンがどこを調整すれば性能を引き出せるかを具体的なカーネル・メモリ局所性の変更点と倍率で示していて、新ハードウェア移行時の推論基盤チューニングの参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: vLLM brings up day-0 support for NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, reusing Blackwell-compatible kernels while adding Rubin-tuned attention, GEMM, and MoE kernels through FlashInfer 0.7.0 and a locality-aware MoE split that uses CUDA 13.4's locality domains so SMs read weights only from the nearest memory. Vera Rubin NVL72 offers 5x the NVFP4 FLOPS, about 2.4x the HBM bandwidth, and 1.7x the bidirectional NVLink bandwidth of GB200 NVL72, and early results show 7.8x the throughput per GPU versus GB200 NVL72 on AgentX at matched interactivity, and up to 3.7x higher VLM throughput versus GB300 NVL72 on MLPerf.
blogs.why_en: Shows concretely which kernel and memory-locality changes a serving engine needs for a new GPU generation and the resulting speedups, a useful reference when moving serving infrastructure to new hardware.

blogs.title: SGLang and Miles on NVIDIA Vera Rubin
blogs.excerpt: We had early access to two NVIDIA Vera Rubin nodes (8 GPUs) and used them to bring SGLang and Miles up on the platform: SGLang for inference and Miles for RL training.
blogs.ja_title: SGLang と Miles を Vera Rubin で動かし、カーネルを 1 段深くして MLA デコードを 16% 高速化
blogs.summary: SGLang/Miles チームは NVIDIA Vera Rubin のノード (8 GPU) を使い、推論は SGLang、RL 学習は Miles (rollout に SGLang、学習に Megatron) で動作確認した。Vera Rubin は 1 CTA あたりの共有メモリが Hopper/Blackwell の 227 KiB から 327 KiB に増えたため、MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) のデコードで K ステージを 1 段、V ステージを 2 段増やした深いパイプラインを組み、長文脈かつバッチ 16・128k コンテキストで 16% の高速化をビット単位で出力を変えずに達成した。Cognition は独自の SGLang ベーススタックで Vera Rubin NVL72 を使い、GB200 NVL72 比で総トークンスループットが最大 4.8 倍になったと報告しているという。
blogs.why: 新世代 GPU の共有メモリ量という具体的なハードウェア制約に合わせてカーネルのパイプライン段数を増やし、出力をビット一致に保ったまま速度を引き出した実例で、推論カーネルのチューニング手法として参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: The SGLang/Miles team got early access to two NVIDIA Vera Rubin nodes (8 GPUs) and brought up both SGLang (inference) and Miles (RL training, using SGLang for rollout and Megatron for training) on the platform. Because Vera Rubin raises per-CTA shared memory from 227 KiB on Hopper/Blackwell to 327 KiB, the team extended MLA decode's pipeline with one more K stage and two more V stages, making MLA at batch 16 and 128k context run 16% faster with bit-identical output; separately, Cognition reports up to a 4.8x increase in total token throughput over GB200 NVL72 with its own SGLang-based stack on Vera Rubin NVL72.
blogs.why_en: A concrete example of retuning kernel pipeline depth to a new GPU generation's shared-memory limit while keeping output bitwise identical, a useful reference for inference kernel tuning.

blogs.title: Mixture-of-Experts kernel engineering on Amazon SageMaker AI
blogs.excerpt: AWS engineers share kernel optimizations for fused Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on Amazon SageMaker AI: Swap-AB for WGMMA utilization, Triton backend routing for FP8 quantization, and eliminating Triton JIT recompilation. Together they deliver up to 10% higher throughput and up to 9% faster Time to First Token on H200 GPUs.
blogs.ja_title: SageMaker AI 向け Fused MoE カーネル最適化、H200 でスループット最大 10% 向上
blogs.summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE、複数の専門家ネットワークを切り替えて使う構造) のモデルは、トークンの振り分け (ルーティング) ・データの並べ替え・専門家の計算を 1 つの GPU 操作にまとめる「fused (融合)」方式にすると速くなるが、実装とデバッグが難しくなる。AWS は Hopper の WGMMA (行列積和の命令) の利用率を上げる Swap-AB、FP8 量子化のルーティングを最適化する Triton バックエンド選択、Triton の JIT 再コンパイルの排除、という 3 つのカーネル最適化を実装した。NVIDIA H200 GPU 上で代表的な MoE モデルに対し、スループットを最大 10%、最初の 1 トークンが出るまでの時間 (Time to First Token) を最大 9% 改善した。
blogs.why: Fused MoE カーネルのハードウェア固有最適化を、どこで・なぜ効くかまで具体的に示しており、MoE 構造の推論基盤を作る人がそのまま応用できる改善点。
blogs.summary_en: Fused MoE merges token routing, data shuffling, and expert computation into a single batched GPU operation, which brings latency advantages but also kernel-implementation and debugging complexity. AWS implemented three kernel optimizations: Swap-AB to improve WGMMA (Warp Group Matrix Multiply Accumulate) utilization on Hopper, Triton backend routing for FP8 quantization, and eliminating Triton JIT recompilation. Together, on a representative MoE model on H200 GPUs, these deliver up to 10% higher throughput and up to 9% faster Time to First Token.
blogs.why_en: It gives concrete, hardware-specific kernel optimizations for fused MoE serving with where and why each one helps, directly usable by anyone building MoE inference infrastructure.

blogs.title: Extending Inductor for the IBM Spyre Accelerator
blogs.excerpt: TL;DR The PyTorch-based software stack for IBM’s Spyre accelerator recently moved its torch.compile backend from sendnn, a separate compilation stack built entirely from scratch, to backend=inductor, an open-source backend built... The post Extending Inductor for the IBM Spyre Accelerator appeared first on PyTorch .
blogs.ja_title: IBM Spyre 向けに PyTorch の Inductor を拡張、独自コンパイラの 7 分の 1 に縮小
blogs.summary: IBM の推論向けアクセラレータ Spyre は、32 個の小さなコアをリング状につなぎ、共有キャッシュではなく各コアが 2 MB のローカルスクラッチパッドを持ち、128 バイト単位の「stick」でデータを動かす、GPU とは違う設計を持つ。torch-spyre はこれまで sendnn というゼロから作った独自コンパイラスタックを使っていたが、PyTorch 自身のコンパイラ Inductor を拡張する形 (backend=inductor) に移行した。Inductor の大部分はそのまま使えたが、データの移動・オンチップ領域の管理・コアへの処理の分配という 3 か所で、Spyre の設計が GPU 前提の Inductor の想定と異なり追加の拡張が必要だった。その結果、コンパイラのコード量は以前の約 7 分の 1 まで小さくなった。
blogs.why: 既存の PyTorch コンパイラ基盤 (Inductor) を新しいハードウェア向けに拡張する際に、どこが GPU 前提から外れて追加実装が要るかを具体的に示しており、他のアクセラレータ向けバックエンドを作る人の参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: IBM's inference-focused Spyre accelerator is a dataflow design very different from a GPU: 32 small cores wired together over a ring, each with its own local 2 MB scratchpad rather than a shared cache, moving data in fixed 128-byte "sticks." Torch-spyre moved its torch.compile backend from sendnn, a separate compilation stack built entirely from scratch, to backend=inductor, built by extending PyTorch's own Inductor. Most of Inductor carried over untouched, but the real work concentrated in three places where Spyre's dataflow design diverges from the GPU-shaped assumptions built into Inductor, and the result is a compiler roughly 7x smaller than what it replaced.
blogs.why_en: It shows concretely where a GPU-oriented compiler substrate like Inductor needs out-of-tree extension to target a genuinely different accelerator architecture, useful for anyone building a backend for new hardware.

blogs.title: Session-Aware Agentic Inference with NVIDIA Dynamo
blogs.excerpt: TL;DR Agentic workloads change the traffic an inference server sees. Unlike single-turn chat, an agent session can involve a large initial prefill, repeated model calls, and subagents running in parallel,... The post Session-Aware Agentic Inference with NVIDIA Dynamo appeared first on PyTorch .
blogs.ja_title: NVIDIA Dynamo、セッション単位の ID でエージェント型推論を vLLM/SGLang 横断でキャッシュ最適化
blogs.summary: コーディングエージェントのようなエージェント型のやり取りは、最初に数万トークンにもなる大きな prefill (入力の事前処理) があり、その後も会話のたびに文脈全体を送り直し、並行して複数のサブエージェントが動く、という普通のチャットとは違う形をしている。既存の推論サーバーの多くはリクエスト単位でルーティング・受付・キャッシュを行うため、1 つのセッションを構成する複数の呼び出しのつながりを認識できていない。NVIDIA Dynamo は、セッション単位の共通 ID (論文での「program」や「trajectory」に近い概念) を導入し、リクエスト単位の基盤をセッション (プログラム) 単位の基盤に変えることで、セッションを意識したルーティング・共有 KV キャッシュの索引付け・vLLM と SGLang をまたいだキャッシュの計画的な移動を可能にした。
blogs.why: エージェント型ワークロードのトラフィックの形が普通のチャットと違うことを踏まえ、推論サービングの基盤をリクエスト単位からセッション単位に作り替える設計を示しており、KV キャッシュ再利用を軸に推論コストを削りたい人に直接関わる。
blogs.summary_en: Agentic workloads change the shape of inference traffic: a coding session can open with tens of thousands of tokens of prefill, resend the growing context on every turn, and fan out into many parallel subagent calls, with the KV cache sitting resident while nothing generates between tool calls. Most open-source serving stacks still route, admit, and cache each request independently with no notion of the session tying it to previous turns. NVIDIA Dynamo unifies its work across the router, inference engine, and KV cache manager around a single session-level identifier (close to what papers call a "program" or "trajectory"), turning request-aware infrastructure into program-aware infrastructure and enabling session-aware routing, shared KV cache indexing, and programmatic cache movement across vLLM and SGLang.
blogs.why_en: It reframes serving infrastructure around the session rather than the request to match how agentic traffic actually behaves, directly relevant to anyone trying to cut inference cost through KV cache reuse.

blogs.title: Building Spyre as a Native PyTorch Device
blogs.excerpt: TL;DR Spyre becomes a native PyTorch device by connecting PyTorch’s existing device, allocator, stream, and compiler abstractions through torch-spyre to the Spyre runtime and firmware. PrivateUse1 gives Spyre a real... The post Building Spyre as a Native PyTorch Device appeared first on PyTorch .
blogs.ja_title: Spyre を PyTorch のネイティブデバイスにする、allocator・stream・コンパイラの橋渡し
blogs.summary: IBM の Spyre アクセラレータは、32 個のコアがリングでつながり、各コアが 2 MB のスクラッチパッドを持ち、最大 128 GB の LPDDR5 がテンソルとプログラムを保持する。torch-spyre は PyTorch の PrivateUse1 という仕組みで Spyre に device="spyre" という正式なデバイス身分を与え、PyTorch のアロケータでテンソルをデバイス上に留め、stream (順序づけ) と event (依存関係) の仕組みをランタイムに橋渡しし、コンパイル済みプログラムの起動を型付きの操作列として扱う。これにより、eager 実行とコンパイル実行が 1 つの経路に統一され、起動オーバーヘッドが下がる。
blogs.why: 推論用アクセラレータを PyTorch のデバイス抽象 (device・allocator・stream・event) に正しく組み込む具体的な手順を示しており、新しいハードウェアを PyTorch に統合する人の設計の参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: IBM's Spyre has 32 cores connected by a high-bandwidth ring, each with 2 MB of local scratchpad, and up to 128 GB of LPDDR5 for tensors and programs. Torch-spyre gives Spyre a real device identity via PyTorch's PrivateUse1 mechanism, keeps tensors resident on device="spyre" through the PyTorch allocator, maps PyTorch's stream and event semantics onto the Spyre runtime, and treats launch of a compiled program as a prepared recipe of typed operations over ordered queues rather than a graph-based runtime interface. The result is one unified path for eager and compiled execution with lower launch overhead.
blogs.why_en: It lays out concretely how to wire a new inference accelerator into PyTorch's device, allocator, stream, and event abstractions, useful as a reference for anyone integrating new hardware into PyTorch.

blogs.ja_title: ハイブリッド型モデルのデコードを速くする、状態の持ち方の見直し ReplaySSM
blogs.summary: Mamba-2・Gated DeltaNet (GDN) ・Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) などの SSM (状態空間モデル) 層と、少数の attention 層を組み合わせた「ハイブリッド型」のモデル (NVIDIA Nemotron 3、Qwen3.5〜Qwen3.8、Kimi-K3、GLM-5.3-Flash など) が増えている。SSM 層は、トークンが増えるほど大きくなる KV キャッシュの代わりに固定サイズの状態を使うことでデコードを速くする設計だが、この記事はその状態の持ち方 (storage) 自体を見直すことで、ハイブリッドモデルのデコードをさらに速くする、という内容。
blogs.why: KV キャッシュに依存しないハイブリッド構造のモデルが実際に増えている中で、その状態管理をどう最適化するかという、推論サービング側で直接使える観点を示す。
blogs.summary_en: Hybrid models that interleave state-space model (SSM) layers with a few attention layers — including NVIDIA Nemotron 3, Qwen3.5 through Qwen3.8, Kimi-K3, and GLM-5.3-Flash — use Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet (GDN), or Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) as the SSM layer. SSM layers are designed to make decoding fast by using a fixed-size state in place of a key-value (KV) cache that grows with context length; this post rethinks how that state is stored to make hybrid-model decoding faster still.
blogs.why_en: As hybrid SSM/attention models become more common in production, this gives a concrete angle on optimizing their state storage that matters directly for inference serving.

blogs.ja_title: Meta の広告推薦モデル GEM、LLM 流の構造とスケーリングで広告面を横断統合
blogs.summary: Meta は広告推薦の基盤モデル GEM を、Facebook・Instagram・Reels などサービスごとに別々だった最適化から、全ての広告面のデータと信号を学習する 1 つの中央基盤モデルに統合した。推薦システムは通常 transformer で素直にスケーリング則が効かないという課題に対し、LLM に似たアーキテクチャ Kunlun を最新 GPU ハードウェアと co-design (協調設計) することで、モデルの複雑さを 2.5 倍に拡張できるようにした。その結果、広告面・目的を横断して転換率 (コンバージョン) が 18.9%、クリック率 (CTR) が 12% 向上し、Facebook・Instagram・オフサイト転換でそれぞれ 5.8%・4.1%・1.6% の追加の転換率向上をもたらした。
blogs.why: 推薦システムという transformer のスケーリング則が素直には効かない領域で、LLM 流のアーキテクチャとハードウェア協調設計によってモデルの複雑さをスケールさせた具体例で、学習効率・スケーリングの参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: Meta consolidated its ads recommendation optimizations, previously isolated per surface (Facebook, Instagram, Reels), into a single central foundation model, GEM, that learns from data and signals across all of Meta's ads platforms. Using an LLM-style architecture, Kunlun, co-designed with the latest GPU hardware, Meta addresses the fact that recommender system models do not exhibit the same scaling properties as transformers under empirical scaling laws, enabling 2.5x model complexity. GEM has delivered 18.9% conversion improvement and 12% ad click-through rate (CTR) improvement across Meta's ad surfaces and objectives, plus 5.8%, 4.1%, and 1.6% additional conversion uplift on Facebook, Instagram, and off-site conversion respectively.
blogs.why_en: It is a concrete case of scaling model complexity in a domain — recommender systems — where transformer scaling laws don't naturally hold, through an LLM-style architecture co-designed with hardware, relevant to anyone working on training efficiency and scaling.

Two elasticity levers in the system allow ads recommendation work to expand across opportunistic capacity, without compromising baseline performance. This post describes how we designed and now operate the system at Meta’s scale and how it drives [...] Read More... The post Turning Opportunistic AI Inference Capacity Into Better Ads Recommendations appeared first on Engineering at Meta .
blogs.ja_title: 余った推論容量を広告推薦に回す、Meta の 2 つの弾力制御レバー
blogs.summary: 推論用の GPU 群は全体では容量が足りなくても、チームやリージョン、アクセラレータの種類ごとに見ると局所的に空いている部分がある、という「容量のパラドックス」が起きる。Meta はこの余った容量をまとめて共有プールにし、広告推薦の仕事に回すシステムを作った。評価する候補の広告数を増やす Rank More Ads (RMA) と、より強力なモデルに回すリクエストの割合を増やす Serve Better Models (SBM) という 2 つの弾力制御レバーを使い、物理的・論理的な分離でベースライン業務用の容量を保護しつつ、容量が急に取り上げられたときはサーバー側・クライアント側の両方で価値に基づく負荷制限 (load shedding) により緩やかに性能を落とす。
blogs.why: グローバルには足りないがローカルには空いている推論容量をどう安全に使うか、という容量管理の仕組みを、具体的な制御レバーと保護機構込みで示しており、大規模推論基盤の運用に直接関わる。
blogs.summary_en: Inference fleets face a capacity paradox: they can be globally constrained while meaningful pockets of capacity remain locally idle, spread across team-owned allocations, regions, and accelerator types, and may be reclaimed with little notice. Meta built a system that aggregates these idle pockets into a shared opportunistic capacity pool for ads recommendation, using two complementary elasticity levers — Rank More Ads (RMA), which adjusts the number of candidates evaluated, and Serve Better Models (SBM), which adjusts the share of requests routed to a more powerful model — with physical and logical isolation protecting baseline capacity and value-aware load shedding at both servers and clients to degrade gracefully when capacity is reclaimed.
blogs.why_en: It shows a concrete capacity-management mechanism, with explicit control levers and protection, for safely using inference capacity that is globally scarce but locally idle, directly relevant to operating large-scale inference fleets.

blogs.title: Toward RL on mixed-precision, mixed-accelerator samplers
blogs.excerpt: We trained a model on agentic coding tasks using fully asynchronous RL and mixed-precision, mixed-accelerator samplers. With off-policy correction, training stayed stable through convergence, on par with homogeneous samplers, at a lower cost.
blogs.ja_title: 学習器と違う精度・違うアクセラレータのサンプラーでも安定して RL 学習できる
blogs.summary: 大規模モデルの強化学習 (RL) では、サンプラー (生成役) は普通、学習器 (trainer) と同じアクセラレータ・同じ精度で動かし、2 つのポリシーの数値的な差を小さく保つ。しかし通常の推論サービングでは FP8・MXFP4・NVFP4 のような低精度形式や専用カーネル、長い文脈の prefill に特化したアクセラレータまで自由に使って速度とコストを最適化している。RL では GPU の 80〜85% をサンプリングに使うため、ここに最適化の余地がある。Modal は、学習器と異なる方針 (ポリシー) から出たデータでも学習できる「off-policy correction (オフポリシー補正)」と、必要に応じて自動で拡張縮小するサーバーレス GPU を組み合わせ、6 種類のアクセラレータ上でそれぞれ異なる精度・カーネルのサンプラーを動かしつつ、1 つの BF16 学習器 (B200) を安定して学習させた。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B をエージェント型コーディングタスクで最大 256K トークンの文脈を使って完全非同期の RL で学習し、SWE-bench Pro V2 (学習データと重複なし) とその難問サブセット HARD-51 で評価し、同種のサンプラー構成と同等の性能をより低いコストで達成したとしている。
blogs.why: RL のサンプラーをアクセラレータ・精度ともに学習器から切り離せることを示しており、サンプリングが GPU の大半を占める RL 基盤のコストを削る具体的な道筋になる。
blogs.summary_en: In large-model RL, samplers usually run on the same accelerators and often the same precision as the trainer to keep the two policies numerically close for stable training, while serving systems outside RL are free to use low-precision formats (FP8, MXFP4, NVFP4), co-designed kernels, and even accelerators built just for long-context prefill. Since sampling already takes 80-85% of the GPUs in large RL runs, Modal asks whether mixed-precision, mixed-accelerator samplers — each running its own kernels — can be used while keeping training stable and performant. Using off-policy correction (which lets a trainer learn from data generated by a different policy, with no assumption about why the two policies differ) together with autoscaling serverless GPUs, they trained Qwen3.6-35B-A3B fully asynchronously on agentic coding tasks with up to 256K tokens of context, with samplers on six kinds of accelerators each with its own precision and kernel feeding one BF16 trainer on B200, evaluating on SWE-bench Pro V2 (no overlap with the training set) and its hard subset HARD-51, and report training stayed stable through convergence, on par with homogeneous samplers, at a lower cost.
blogs.why_en: It shows that RL samplers can be decoupled from the trainer in both accelerator type and precision, giving a concrete path to cut the cost of RL infrastructure where sampling dominates GPU usage.

review.note: 評価データに学習データのリーク (参照修正の痕跡など) が混ざらないよう、タスクからリポジトリ履歴やその他の手がかりを取り除いて評価セットを作る、という検証の観点。
review.note_en: A methodology point on building a leak-free eval set by removing repository history and other traces through which tasks could leak the reference fix, so the held-out benchmark doesn't overlap with training data.

blogs.title: Endpoint Candidates: evaluate and promote inference endpoints
blogs.excerpt: Test and promote inference endpoints to evaluate quality, latency, throughput, and cost.
blogs.ja_title: 推論エンドポイントを本番前に本番トラフィックで試す仕組み (Endpoint Candidates)
blogs.summary: 推論サーバーの品質・レイテンシ・スループット・コストを比べたくても、トラフィックミラーリング (本番の通信を複製して流す仕組み) を自前で作るのは大変だという困りごとに対し、Modal は既存の本番エンドポイントに「候補 (Candidate)」として新しいモデルや設定をつなぎ、本番トラフィックの一部をコピーして流しながら評価できる Endpoint Candidates を作った。候補ごとに別々の上限付きバッファ (bounded buffer) にリクエストを分けて転送する設計にすることで、遅い候補の処理待ちが本番の応答を遅らせないようにした。良ければダッシュボードからそのまま本番へ昇格 (promote) できる。
blogs.why: 分散推論・サービングの運用者にとって、モデル入れ替えや新チェックポイントの検証を安全に本番環境で行う仕組みの実例として参考になる。
blogs.summary_en: Modal built Endpoint Candidates so teams can stage alternative deployments next to a production Dedicated Endpoint and mirror a sample of production traffic to them, to evaluate quality, latency, throughput, and cost before promoting a candidate to production. The hard part was keeping slow mirrors from holding up production: Modal extended its Pingora-based proxy to fork each request stream into a separate, bounded buffer per Candidate, so a slow Candidate's buffering doesn't block the original production response.
blogs.why_en: Gives serving infrastructure builders a concrete design (per-candidate bounded buffers on a shared proxy) for safely testing new models or checkpoints against live production traffic.
